name: two_things_at_once
title: Home · two things at once: a watch opens an item, a question is answered in Home, a follow-up continues the item

steps.say: watch We Work Remotely for back-end roles
steps.reply:
I'm now watching We Work Remotely's back-end category. It checks every morning at 08:00 (or when your Mac next wakes) and tells you which roles are new and which have been taken down.

The category has only 5 roles at the moment. All are full-time, and they're in a new **Back-end jobs** table under **Job search**:

| Role | Company | Who can apply | Posted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Senior Backend Developer (Python) | Proxify AB | Anywhere | ~19 Oct |
| Senior Backend Developer (Node.js / Nest.js) | Proxify AB | Anywhere | ~19 Oct |
| Staff Software Engineer, Revenue Systems | Squarespace | Anywher
steps.routed_by: judge: A request to watch a job board for back-end roles is a standing watch, which needs a new work item.

steps.detail: went to Back-end Job Watch (new; judge: A request to watch a job board for back-end roles is a standing watch, which needs a new work item.)

steps.say: how many eggs have I logged this week
steps.reply:
You haven't logged any eggs. The only thing I'm keeping for you right now is your job search, and the only mention of eggs anywhere is this question.

If you'd like to start tracking them, just tell me as you go, like "2 eggs at breakfast." I'll keep a running log and can give you weekly totals.
steps.routed_by: judge: A question about egg logs is unrelated to the job watch item, and it can be answered by looking up logged data this turn.

steps.detail: went to Home (home; judge: A question about egg logs is unrelated to the job watch item, and it can be answered by looking up logged data this turn.)

steps.say: make that watch check every day at 7
steps.reply: The Back-end Job Watch now checks every day at 07:00, or when your Mac next wakes if it's asleep then. The first check is this morning at 07:00.
steps.routed_by: judge: "That watch" refers to the Back-end Job Watch, and the request changes its schedule from 08:00 to 07:00.
